caption: The drawing depicts five large, roughly humanoid figures and several smaller abstract shapes against a brown, textured background. The largest figures are colored predominantly in blue, with red and white outlines and accents. On the left side, two blue figures with red and white borders stand close together, one much smaller than the other, with the larger figure holding a rounded object with a stem. Next to them is another abstract figure in white with a solid blue rectangle in its center and red detailing near its head. In the middle to right of the scene, there are multiple small pink and red shapes, and on the far right, there is a tall blue figure with elongated arms that are fringed with red lines and bordered in white. The entire composition is sketched on a tan background, with a darker brown filling the upper 3/4 of the rectangle. There is a thin, wavy black line running horizontally near the middle, with several small peaks. The figures have exaggerated, stylized features and are arranged in a row near the center of the drawing.
title: Petroglyph - Human Figures
